text:
harper: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A about parental accommodations, guest rules for offsites, and a couple of travel edge cases. Dropping answers here so folks can find them.

director-people: Short answers: parental accommodations are considered case-by-case; for mandatory multi-day events managers can request childcare stipend or lodging split for dependents. Guests/partners are allowed only for informal regional socials and must be manager-cleared; not allowed at customer-facing or strategy offsites.

people-ops-bot: Parental & guest policy draft uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/policies/parents_offsites (edited)

vp-people: For mandatory training that requires travel, managers should request pre-approval at least 7 business days out for childcare stipend. Reimbursement needs receipts and a brief manager note. Routine childcare is not covered.

finance: Expense note: use Expense Type: "Childcare Stipend" with attached receipt and manager approval. If lodging is shared for family, include split payment proof and justification.

it-ops: Operational note: any offsite that requires access to internal tools from an external location needs a VPN exception and device check at least 5 business days before travel. No exceptions for sensitive systems.

harper: What about last-minute family emergency travel?

director-people: We handle emergencies flexibly. Manager approval + receipts after the fact will usually work; open a people-ops ticket and mark it urgent.

ceo: Leadership add-on: we want to be supportive of caregivers. If you face a barrier to attending a mandatory event because of caregiving, escalate to your manager and people-ops will prioritize review.

harper: Hoteling hiccup question: recurring desk owners keep losing reservations when meetings are scheduled. Any interim fix?

director-people: New hoteling flow rolls out next sprint. Interim priority: meeting organizer > recurring desk owner > one-off hoteling. If you see a conflict, post a screenshot in #desk-ops and ops will reconcile.

people-ops-bot: FAQ one-pager will be added to the all-hands follow-ups: https://intranet.redwood/allhands/parental_accommodations_faq (edited)

harper: Thanks — I’ll collect volunteers to review the one-pager and make it concise for managers.

vp-people: I can review the wording for accommodations.

director-people: Closing thread for edits at 1781236800. DM for urgent exceptions.
